blocked_or_insufficient.reason: The official 2025/26 squad photo and official announcement do not provide a complete official shirt-number register. The currently accessible official squad page is a later live roster, so using it would mix seasons. Under the requested rule, do not output an incomplete 18-35 player list.

The official 2025/26-era squad page is preserved as an archive.org snapshot, but its player-card content is dynamically rendered and the retrieved snapshot does not expose a complete, verifiable set of official shirt numbers. The live Bayer 04 squad page has already rolled over to 2026/27. Transfermarkt and Bundesliga can corroborate candidate names, positions and some numbers, but under the requested rule they cannot substitute for official shirt-number evidence. Because official shirt-number coverage is incomplete, no partial or reconstructed player list is emitted.

官方 2025/26 季前集訓公告提供 35 名球員及背號，但其中包含其後在夏窗離隊或租借離隊者；官方 first-team 頁在可讀頁面未提供可核對的 2025/26 歷史完整名單，且官方夏窗總結僅確認最終為 24 名場上球員、3 名門將及 2 名 academy players，未在可讀內容中逐人列出最終名單與全部背號。Transfermarkt 可補國籍及位置，但其 25/26 頁顯示的是混合賽季後 current-club 狀態，不能單獨證明最終男子一隊歸屬。依 F 批規則，無法在每名球員同時滿足「最終 2025/26 男子一隊」「官方背號」「至少兩個公開 URL」前，不輸出不完整名單。

policy: F批放寬仍要求每人name/position/shirt_number/nationality/season=2025/26、至少2公開來源及至少1官方來源；沒有完整官方背號即保留tier0，不創作。
